name: Contains Network Interface
description: This host's operating system has this network interface: eth0, ens5, a virtual equivalent. Containment: the interface exists only as part of the host, so it retires when the host does (computing_core__host lists this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES). Exactly one per network_interface, drawn to the host whose spine natural key (host_type|stable_id) is the interface's tap.computing.host dimension (req-computing-core-interface-3).
